info.desc: Released 1983, Suicidal Tendencies is the self titled debut album by Mike "Cyco Miko" Muir lead metal band Suicidal Tendencies. .

podcast.body: The band's self-titled debut album was released in 1983 and is cited as a prime example of California hardcore, showcasing early elements of trash metal and skate punk. "that's suicidal tendencies with institutionalized from their 1983 self-titled debut album."
